home.title: Your creativity. Your people. Your own space.
home.description: Fellowa brings your work and your supporters together around a page that is yours. Build closer connections with the people who value what you create.
home.whyBody: Creative work grows through meaningful relationships. A dedicated home makes room for your voice, your work, and the people who want to be part of it.
home.whyNote: A place to create, share, and grow together.
home.featuresBody: The Fellowa experience brings these ideas together in one place.
home.pageBody: A dedicated space to introduce yourself, share your story, and bring your creative work together.
home.membershipBody: Membership brings creators and their supporters together around shared interests and creative work.
home.contentBody: Give your ideas room to grow through writing, audio, images, and the stories behind your work.
home.closingTitle: Make space for what you create
home.closingBody: Take a look around the creator studio.
